Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:

>Here is the situation:

>does it go through and he only can prevent normal damage?
>

>Thanks,
>
>Keven Murphy
>xav...@enc-1.com

Skin of Rock prevents 1 or 2 damage. Assuming your hand damage is only
1 or 2 (you didn't play Undead Strength with Zac, say) it will prevent
it. Prevent Damage will prevent either normal or aggro damage and if a
strike does both types of damage and you can only prevent some of it,
you can choose which to prevent first.

One of the Sabbat cards will only prevent non-aggravated damage at one
particular level, and Flesh of Marble won't at inferior.

Messages.Author: Quicksilver
Messages.Body:
kmu...@tardis.svsu.edu wrote:
Here is the situation:

I use Wolf claws to inflict Ag. Damage. My opponent plays a Skin of
Rock (or Skin of Steel).  Does that card prevent the Ag. Damage? Or
does it go through and he only can prevent normal damage?

Thanks,

Keven Murphy
xav...@enc-1.com

 This one is easy. Damage prevention cards can prevent normal or aggravated
damage. In addition, if both types are dealt (say 1 point of normal and 2 points
of aggravated as when the cheesy Zip Gun/Dragons's Breath Rounds), the
vampire that played the damage prevention may choose which type of damage to
prevent first. In the case cited, a Skin of Rock could be used to prevent the 2
aggravated damage butn not the 1 normal damage.

Only a card that specifically prohibits preventing agg damage
performs like that. See Resilience for an example.
